subject: HexaLogistics POC wrap: metrics recap + quick reference ask

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: HexaLogistics POC wrap: metrics recap + quick reference ask

Hi Sofia / Tom,

Thanks again for running the two-week POC with us — appreciate the collaboration. I wanted to share a concise recap of the operational improvements we observed during the pilot and ask a small favour if you’re open to it. Attached is a short metrics snapshot and a visualization we pulled from the run (Hexa_PoC_metrics_snapshot.pdf, hexalogistics_kpi_chart.png).

POC highlights (rolling 7-day windows, averaged):
- Inference latency: median down from 215ms -> 68ms (68% improvement)
- Cost per 1K tokens: estimated reduction of ~47% when using batching + prefix cache
- Throughput: sustained 3.1k requests/minute on your representative traffic shape
- Error rate: dropped from 0.9% -> 0.2% after routing and fallback policy tweaks

These translated into improved fulfillment throughput and fewer retry incidents for your ingestion pipeline during peak windows. We believe these numbers are representative of what a production rollout could standardize across your EU/US regions.

Would you be comfortable providing a one- or two-sentence quote we can use in a brief customer spot (marketing + sales collateral)? Example: "Redwood cut our inference latency by two-thirds and materially reduced our per-request costs during the POC, enabling smoother peak processing." If helpful, Marissa (cc’d) can draft three one-liners for you to pick from.

If you prefer, we can do a quick 10-minute call to capture a short soundbite on Thursday or Friday next week — whatever’s easiest. No heavy lift.

Thanks again,

Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192 | dylan@redwood.ai

Hi Dylan —

Appreciate the clear summary and the attachments. The team is pretty happy with the latency and stability gains; those are exactly the kinds of wins we needed to justify the next-phase budget. I ran the snapshot by Tom and he asked me to provide a short piece we can sign off on.

You can use this line: "During the POC, Redwood reduced median inference latency by roughly 2/3 and helped us bring down per-request costs — a clear signal that a production rollout will pay for itself."

We’re also fine doing a 10-minute call if you need a live soundbite — Nov 9 between 10–11am PT works for me and Tom.

Best,
